theme: published research recommendations and project priorities
question: Which explicit recommendations from Indus archaeology, epigraphy and computation can this repository act on with current evidence?
outcome: The source rebuild admits 59 recommendations drawn from 28 sources, with 35 total source records across six themes; 22 of 25 requested researchers have an admitted recommendation. Four lecture rows use the coordinator caption check. Seven positions are separate. All 33 original rows have a disposition, 14 reviewed source records have correction notes and 16 missing-item leads have dispositions. Chronological, regional and object-context work recurs in opened sources; priorities reuse D1, D2, E, G, H and the evidence census.
challenge: The first pass contained unsupported attributions, metadata errors and encoding damage. Several full texts and three roster recommendation passages remain unavailable. Windows error 112 interrupted the rebuild; continuation found no truncated saved file. Lecture captions were checked by the coordinator, not independently by this package.
remedy: Preserved 19 files byte for byte in first-pass; read explicit author passages and removed inferred/empty rows; added scoped published replies, witness hashes, encoding and export checks; corrected Fuls denominator description and repository links; recorded access gaps and kept third-party payloads local.
retry_when: New inspectable agenda passages, full texts or an independently read lecture transcript become available; a reviewer identifies a specific attribution error; or improved object/date/context joins permit a bounded priority test.
